# rixl_blog_subscription (Resource)

Manages a user's subscription preference to Rixl blog and product updates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_blog_subscription" "newsletter" {
  user_id    = "usr_01h7abc123"
  subscribed = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscribed` (Boolean)

### Optional

- `user_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `subscribed_at` (String)
